name: The wide park
blurb: Almost every dot is free. One line is still best.
aside: Two treats and the stick at A2 are on one line: up column A, then across row 2, through the water and the cave. She finishes with 5 energy. That line scores −10. The right-hand walk takes the first treat and the ball at F7, misses both sticks, and scores −11. The stick at C1 is the walk over the top. It keeps the treats and the stick at A2, and it scores −11.
